classification.difficultyReason: Translate a majority of five into at least three successes and sum binomial probabilities.

content.prompt: A poll indicates that 55% of people support the policies of the Working Together Party. If five people are selected at random, what is the probability that a majority of them will support WTP party policies? Give your answer correct to three decimal places.

answer.worked:
Let $X$ be the number who support WTP policies. Then $X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(5,0.55)$. A majority means at least three people.
$$\begin{align*}P(X\ge3)&=P(X=3)+P(X=4)+P(X=5)\\&=\binom53(0.55)^3(0.45)^2+\binom54(0.55)^4(0.45)+(0.55)^5\\&=0.593126875\\&\approx0.593.\end{align*}$$
